name: Total generation
definition: Total electricity generated in a country in a given year across all sources.
formula: Sum of generation across all sources (Ember 'Total generation')

name: Renewable share of generation
definition: The percentage of a country's annual electricity generation that comes from renewable sources.
formula: (Hydro + Bioenergy + Wind + Other renewables + Solar) ÷ Total generation × 100

name: Fossil share of generation
definition: The percentage of a country's annual electricity generation that comes from fossil fuels.

name: Carbon intensity of electricity
definition: The greenhouse-gas emissions released per unit of electricity generated in a year.

name: Renewable share of installed capacity
definition: The percentage of a country's installed generating capacity that is renewable.
formula: Renewable capacity ÷ total generating capacity × 100, Ember grid capacity basis (large hydro included, as in the official ASEAN definition; official figures also count off-grid and rooftop capacity, so they run higher)

name: Electricity demand per person
definition: The average electricity demand per resident of a country in a given year.

name: Capacity factor
definition: How much a source generated compared with running at full capacity all year.
formula: Generation (TWh) × 1000 ÷ (capacity (GW) × hours in year; 8784 in leap years)

name: Demand growth
definition: Year-on-year change in a country's electricity demand.
formula: (Demand this year − demand last year) ÷ demand last year × 100

name: Power-sector emissions
definition: Greenhouse-gas emissions from electricity generation in a year.
formula: Ember 'Emissions (MtCO2e)' on the Total generation row

name: System Average Interruption Frequency Index
definition: Average number of sustained interruptions per customer per year.
formula: Total customer interruptions ÷ total customers served

name: System Average Interruption Duration Index
definition: Average minutes of interruption per customer per year.
formula: Sum of customer interruption durations ÷ total customers served
